title: Payment Extension Returned-Payment Share — Decision Table
content:
# Payment Extension Returned-Payment Share — Decision Table

**Rule.** For a Payment Extension — the single-installment kind of Payment Arrangement — enrolled on a residential agreement under disconnection notice, the returned-payment share is read from the returned-payment charges posted to any of the customer's Electric Service Agreements within the 12 months before enrollment:

| Returned-payment charges on any of the customer's Electric Service Agreements within the 12 months | Returned-payment share |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 10% |
| Exactly one | 5% |
| None | 0 |

All of the customer's agreements are counted together, not only the agreement under notice. A window of 12 months before enrollment covers charges posted after the same calendar day 12 months earlier, up to and including the enrollment date.

## Input — judgement — output (hypothetical customer with two agreements)

| Charges within the window | Judgement | Share |
|---|---|---|
| One on the home agreement, one on a second agreement | Two in total | 10% |
| One on the second agreement only | Exactly one | 5% |
| One posted 13 months before enrollment | Outside the window | 0 |
